response.courseDescription: 425 Soil and Site Improvement Compaction theory and methods; deep densification of soils; advanced consolidation theory, preloading, vertical drains, chemical stabilization, grouting; use of geosynthetics. Required preparation for graduate students must include CE 317. Credit not granted for both CE 425 and CE 525. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: CE 317 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Civil Engineering.
